CEDARLINE MANUFACTURING AGREEMENT

This Cedarline Manufacturing Agreement is entered into as of February 1, 2025 (the "Effective Date"), by and between Cedarline Devices, Inc. ("Customer") and Brightpath Assembly, LLC ("Manufacturer").

1. Liability

1.1 Cap. The aggregate liability of Manufacturer shall not exceed USD 250000.00.

1.2 Exclusions. In no event shall either party be liable for indirect, incidental, special, or consequential damages.

2. Indemnity

2.1 Third Parties. Manufacturer shall indemnify Customer against any third-party claim without limitation.

3. Warranty

3.1 Term. Manufacturer warrants the products for twelve (12) months from the date of shipment and shall repair or replace defective products.

4. Termination

4.1 Convenience. Either party may terminate this Agreement for convenience by written notice at least ninety (90) days before the termination date.

4.2 Survival. Sections 1, 2, and 3 survive expiration or termination of this Agreement.

5. Forecast and Supply

5.1 Forecast. Customer shall provide a rolling twelve (12) month forecast.

5.2 End of Life. Manufacturer shall give written notice of end-of-life at least one hundred eighty (180) days before the last time buy date.

6. Consigned Inventory

6.1 Title. Title to consigned inventory remains with Customer, and Manufacturer shall not buy the consigned inventory unless the parties agree in writing.

7. Late Fees

7.1 Interest. Late amounts shall accrue a late fee of one percent (1%) per month.
